scope: Read-only aggregation of the already-completed shell_gate_attempt3 and shell_routed_opt fixed/dynamic logs plus targeted connectivity inspection of their referenced netlists. No simulation, synthesis, TD, training, checker, RTL, or netlist was started or changed.
counting_note: Each number below was recounted from the SHA-256-bound final log. shell_gate_attempt3/fixed_stress.log independently yields 102027 warnings; equality with the older attempt2 total is coincidental and is not a reuse of the old count.

gate_attempt3_dynamic.interpretation: The log loads the existing optimized design, so elaboration-time vopt warning families are not repeated. It is a separate workload result, not a second warning-free elaboration.

routed_opt_dynamic.interpretation: The log reuses the routed optimized design; only runtime type-compatibility warnings recur.

gate_attempt3.other: One parameter-only CONFIG cell, one constant LUT input warning duplicated at vopt/vsim.

lslice_superset.note: Placement/routing maps registers and logic into physical LSLICE cells, replacing the gate netlist's separate AL_MAP_SEQ bucket and expanding the vendor supercell interface warnings. Each dpram_* LSLICE port is omitted 5957 times; these are not the SiLU ERAM wea port.

connected_type_mismatches.note: These are incompatible connected types, not missing connections.

necessary_differences.root_cause: The increase is overwhelmingly physical LSLICE supercell expansion after placement/routing: 8029 routed LSLICE instances versus 3511 gate LSLICE instances. DSP, IO-pad, ERAM, and undriven DSP-control counts remain structurally the same; a small number of route-inserted clock/bank-reference cells is new.

mac_operands.gate_evidence: physical_attempt3/gate_netlist.v:111517 and following connects clk, controls, xa=reg_activation_front_b, y=reg_weight_front_b, multiplier internal buses and product.
mac_operands.routed_evidence: physical_opt/routed_netlist.v:122642-122656 preserves clk, xa=reg_activation_front_b, y=reg_weight_front_b, controls, internal multiplier buses and product.
mac_operands.warning_check: Neither netlist's DSP missing-port list contains xa or y. The unchanged 408 MAC open_n warnings are control/config-vector positions and remain a model-fidelity risk, not proof of absent operands.

mac_bias.gate_evidence: physical_attempt3/gate_netlist.v:95478 and 117388 retain reg_mac_bias and reg_bias_dot register paths.
mac_bias.routed_evidence: physical_opt/routed_netlist.v:96997-97005 maps reg_mac_bias[0] with reset, clock, data/control inputs and output; 127198-127205 maps reg_bias_dot[0] with data/control inputs and output.
mac_bias.warning_check: Bias-related physical cells omit unused LSLICE supercell ports, but their effective data, clock/control and output ports are present.

silu_eram.gate_evidence: physical_attempt3/gate_netlist.v:192968-192970 selects CSA0=1, CSA1=1, CSA2=SIG; 193073 and following connects addra, clka, csa, dia, dia_extra, wea, doa and doa_extra.
silu_eram.routed_evidence: physical_opt/routed_netlist.v:197622-197624 keeps the same chip-select configuration; 197727-197735 connects addra, routed clka, csa[2]=flag_pipeline_enable, dia, dia_extra, wea=flag_table_write_enable, doa and doa_extra.
silu_eram.warning_check: The 27 omitted ERAM ports are the unused B side and optional ECC/FIFO/cascade/probe/output-register controls. LSLICE dpram_we warnings are a different primitive family.

residual_risks: 474 undriven DSP control/config open_n nets remain in both final fixed elaborations
Gate and routed simulations retain 621 and 580 connected-port type mismatches respectively
Cached dynamic runs do not repeat elaboration diagnostics
Two passing workloads do not validate unexercised vendor primitive modes
closure_decision.minimum_close_path: Treat fixed logs as the elaboration warning inventory and dynamic logs as separate functional workloads. Preserve the passing evidence, but close vendor-model fidelity only with the exact matching primitive library/netlist pair or a regenerated vendor netlist, followed by both workloads. Do not change MAC arithmetic, latency, handshake, or ERAM protocol merely to suppress vendor superset-port warnings.
closure_decision.extra_authorization: No additional authorization was needed for this read-only audit. Any vendor-library swap, netlist regeneration, or external-tool rerun needs explicit workflow authorization.
